snippet.title: Anxiety Arcade Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Anxiety Arcade is a surreal narrative game built for a full-sized arcade cabinet. Explore a digital world of songs, puzzles, and mini-games inspired by 80s pop culture and the feeling of endless anxiety.

Releases Q1 2026 on Steam. Wishlist now.
